baseline_models.focus_anchor: Words 1-5 join active driving, a culpable human object, the destination Jahannam, and the arrival-state noun wirdan.
baseline_models.mechanism: The driving branch gives externally controlled herd-motion; the offense branch identifies why this cohort is selected; the water-arrival branch frames the destination as a sought or reached watering point whose expected relief is inverted by Jahannam.

activation_trace.role: Driving, herding, and expulsion supply the coercive motion and remove control from the moved cohort.
Offense and wrongdoing supply the culpable classification that selects the driven group.
Arrival at a destination, especially water, supplies the terminal posture and makes Jahannam an inverted watering-place.

changed_reading.before: The criminals are simply taken to Hell.
changed_reading.after: They are driven without route-control like a herd brought to water, while Jahannam turns the expected place of relief into the destination itself.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The plural object al-mujrimin stands between a driving verb and wirdan, allowing the movement to be heard as an ordered mode of entry rather than a bare transfer.
baseline_models.mechanism: Following in one track and entering successively combine into a processional intake: the cohort remains plural, but its motion has sequence and staging.

activation_trace.role: Successive following in one track supplies the ordered file of the transport.
The offense branch supplies a common legal class without implying voluntary cohesion.
Progressive, piece-by-piece entry turns arrival into staged intake.

changed_reading.before: The verse pictures one undifferentiated mass movement.
changed_reading.after: The verse can picture a controlled convoy whose members follow one track and are fed into the destination successively.

context_deltas.mechanism: Prior agitation compresses the cohort, while repeated counting meters the delay before transport; the focus drive can therefore be read as the release stage of an already pressured and regulated process.

activation_trace.role: Compression and crowding until space narrows supply an upstream pressure that forms the cohort for movement.
Enumeration supplies regulation and a measured interval between agitation and transport.
Coercive driving converts the accumulated pressure into directed movement.
Successive entry supplies the regulated intake produced by pressure and count.

structural_cues: The 19:83-86 sequence places counted delay between intense agitation and the paired movements of 19:85-86.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies crowding, enumeration, driving, and successive entry; I infer that pressure is upstream of the drive and count meters its release. A live alternative is that 19:83 concerns moral incitement and 19:84 temporal reckoning without describing transport mechanics.

changed_reading.before: The drive begins as a single unexplained act of expulsion.
changed_reading.after: The drive is the transfer stage of a metered process: pressure forms the cohort, counting regulates it, and successive entry receives it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding assembly toward the Merciful ends in the social posture of a delegation; the focus repeats the motion-to-destination frame but replaces protected delegates with culpable persons and delegated arrival with driven water-arrival. The pair defines two opposed modes of reception.

activation_trace.role: Gathering and driving a group to a goal supplies the matched collective-motion frame.
Placing oneself under protection supplies the positive cohort's protected status.
Mercy and tenderness make the first destination relationally receptive.
Arrival before an authority as a delegation supplies recognized social standing at reception.
Herding and expulsion replace the preceding cohort's gathered approach with coercion.
Culpability replaces protected status as the basis of classification.
Water-arrival replaces formal delegation as the cohort's terminal posture.

structural_cues: 19:85 and 19:86 share first-person plural motion verbs, ila destinations, plural human objects, and final accusative arrival-state nouns.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies close grammatical parallelism and opposed branch images; I infer a deliberate contrast between reception modes. The live alternative is looser juxtaposition rather than a term-for-term antithesis.

changed_reading.before: The criminals merely form a negative crowd headed to punishment.
changed_reading.after: They are the counter-delegation: unlike the protected group received before the Merciful with recognized standing, they are handled as a coerced water-bound cohort whose destination determines the terror of its arrival.

context_deltas.mechanism: Solitary arrival before and after the focus, the inability to control intercession, and universal servant-status dissolve any supportive meaning in the plural cohort. The group is logistical: members share a route but cannot supply one another with standing.

activation_trace.role: The isolated individual supplies a pre-focus endpoint of unsupported arrival.
Possession and power of disposal, explicitly restricted here, remove autonomous control over rescue.
An advocate joining another supplies the unavailable supportive attachment within or beyond the cohort.
Owned-servant status removes independent standing and route-control at arrival.
Repeated solitary arrival supplies the post-focus disaggregation of every collective.
Following in one track explains how isolated persons can nevertheless be transported as one file.
Successive entry supplies the point at which a plural convoy can expose members one by one.

structural_cues: The focus plural is bracketed by fardan in 19:80 and 19:95, while 19:87 restricts intercession immediately after the drive.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated solitary arrival, restricted intercession, servant-status, and serial movement; I infer corporate transport followed by individual exposure. A live alternative is that individuality describes only the final audience and not the mechanics of the route.

changed_reading.before: The plural criminals may seem socially consolidated by their common fate.
changed_reading.after: They are a cohort only for transport: unable to attach an unauthorized advocate, they follow one route but arrive without transferable standing, each exposed alone.

context_deltas.mechanism: Counting before the focus and exhaustive enumeration after it turn the serial intake into a lossless manifest: the route processes a complete, known set rather than an anonymous crowd.

activation_trace.role: Counting before the focus supplies a measured precursor to movement.
Totality and enclosure supply the complete scope of those arriving.
Exhaustive numerical reckoning supplies exact reconciliation of the transported population.
Repeated enumeration confirms that no member remains an unindexed part of the crowd.
One-track succession gives the manifest an ordered transport form.
An allotted or timed turn gives each arrival a scheduled place in the reckoned sequence.

structural_cues: The doubled count in 19:84 precedes the focus, and exhaustive counting in 19:94 follows it; kull reinforces total scope in 19:93 and 19:95.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated counting, exhaustive scope, one-track succession, and allotted turns; I infer that the transport is reconciled like a complete manifest. A live alternative is that 19:84 counts time rather than persons, though 19:94 explicitly restores personal enumeration.

changed_reading.before: The ordered procession could still be an anonymous mass.
changed_reading.after: It is an exhaustively inventoried transfer: every member is known, placed in the sequence, and delivered with none hidden inside the plural.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because marketplace, acquisition, and allotted-turn senses form a cross-domain accounting analogy rather than the surface scene. It remains anchored in three focus branches and is sharpened by explicit exhaustive reckoning in 19:94; downstream prose should call it a settlement analogy, not claim that Jahannam is literally a market.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The three focus roots can align as market, acquisition, and allotted due: suq at word 1, j-r-m at word 2, and wird at word 5.

activation_trace.role: The marketplace supplies a bounded venue where acquisitions and liabilities are settled.
Acquisition and causing acquisition recast culpability as what the persons have brought onto their account.
An allotted or recurring turn supplies the moment at which the acquired liability comes due.
Exhaustive reckoning activates the accounting relation among the focus branches.

changed_reading.before: The verse presents only a punitive journey.
changed_reading.after: As a contained analogy, the journey also resembles settlement: what was acquired as culpability reaches its fully reckoned and allotted due.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is form-distant because al-mujrimin conventionally names offenders, not cut fragments. It remains anchored in the cutting and post-harvest-remnant branches of j-r-m and is activated by the explicit opening, splitting, and demolition sequence in 19:90; downstream prose should preserve it only as a secondary severance image, never as a replacement gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The j-r-m form at word 2 carries branch images of cutting and what remains after cutting, while the focus verb moves that marked cohort away.

activation_trace.role: Cutting and severance supply the image of persons marked by rupture and then cut off.
Remnants left after cutting supply the contained image of a residual cohort removed from the field.
Expulsion supplies the removal of the severed remnant toward its destination.
Opening and cracking activate the material register of severance.
Splitting and opening extend the rupture image from the culpable class into the surrounding order.
Severe breaking and demolition supply the terminal material consequence of that rupture.

changed_reading.before: Al-mujrimin functions only as a legal label for offenders.
changed_reading.after: As a secondary image, those who enact rupture become a severed remnant driven away within a context where false attribution threatens to split and demolish the created order.

strongest_changes: The parallel with 19:85 recasts 19:86 as an opposed reception mode: recognized delegation before the Merciful versus coerced water-arrival at Jahannam.
Counting on both sides of the focus turns the drive into an exhaustive, staged intake rather than chaotic mass movement.
Solitary arrival and restricted intercession strip supportive solidarity from the plural cohort.
summary.what_was_special: The focus compresses coercive motion, culpable classification, and a water-arrival noun into one line; nearby parallel syntax, enumeration, and solitary presentation activate social, logistical, and accountability mechanisms without resolving them into one reading.
remaining_uncertainties: Wirdan may foreground destination-arrival, a watering cohort, or an allotted turn in different models.
The serial branches may indicate actual temporal batching or only the visual manner of approach.
The marketplace and severance constellations remain exploratory analogies rather than replacement glosses.
